title: The Alpha and His Nanny Luna
description: A werewolf-romance vertical series pairing a powerful alpha with the nanny raising his child, as duty, pack politics, and growing feelings collide.
descriptionMore: Hired to care for the alpha's child, the nanny ends up at the center of pack business she never signed up for — and at the center of the alpha's attention too. The series works the familiar shifter-romance beats of hierarchy, rivalry, and fated attraction across 50 vertical episodes.
